known_high_risk_items: Page 312 prints an internally inconsistent Odisha mangrove row; preserve the print and teach the corrected ISFR 2023 value.
Page 313 duplicates the Nellore district mangrove row and omits Eluru in the visible sequence; reconstruct from official ISFR Table 3.4.
Pages 320-324 mix protected-area categories and older/current names; each cell requires current official classification.
Page 325 treats Western Ghats, a serial World Heritage property, like one national park; correct the category.
Page 327 contains time-sensitive species-project totals; score only dated, verified values.
